jobs.occupation: Innovation & New Ventures Lead
jobs.description:
Strategy and business development

Innovation & New Ventures Lead

Imagine a future where you build entirely new businesses that accelerate the green transition and unlock new sources of value.

We offer a workplace culture where you´ll arrange with your people leader when you can work from home and from the office.

Working hours Full-time

Why join?

Proven very high employee satisfaction and motivation

Continuous development opportunities for all employees

Competitive salary, pension scheme, and attractive holiday package

A wide range of health benefits, such as health insurance, nutritious food, and fitness facilities in our office locations

Join us in this role where you’ll originate and build new ventures from the ground up, turning bold ideas into scalable businesses. You’ll shape opportunities, validate them with the market, and drive early commercialisation, working across functions and leveraging the strength of a global organisation.

Welcome to Ventures & Open Innovation

You’ll be part of a team focused on identifying and scaling transformational opportunities, where you together with your colleagues will explore new markets, business models, and technologies. You’ll collaborate closely across engineering, commercial, and business development functions to bring new ideas to life. As a team, we support each other, challenge ideas constructively, and work with curiosity and ownership to turn ambition into impact.

You’ll play an important role in:

• 
originating new business opportunities by identifying white spaces and shaping opportunity areas

• 
leading end-to-end venture building from ideation through validation to early commercialisation

• 
designing and testing business models through structured experimentation and rapid learning

• 
collaborating with internal stakeholders to unlock capabilities and move opportunities forward

• 
translating technical assets and capabilities into new commercial propositions

• 
contributing to innovation strategy and portfolio prioritisation.

To succeed in the role, you:

• 
have hands-on experience building new businesses or ventures from concept to launch

• 
bring a strong commercial mindset, focusing on customers, value creation, and revenue models

• 
are comfortable working across ambiguity and can create structure and direction independently

• 
collaborate effectively with both technical and commercial stakeholders, or equivalent experience

• 
demonstrate curiosity and quickly build understanding in new industries or domains

• 
communicate clearly and persuasively, building alignment around new ideas.

Maybe you’ve read the above and can see you have some transferable skills, even though they don’t quite match all the points. If you think you can bring something to the team, we still encourage you to apply.

Shape the future with us

Send your application to us as soon as possible. We’ll be conducting interviews on a continuous basis and reserve the right to take down the advert when we’ve found the right candidate.

As an applicant or employee, you may request reasonable work and position accommodation or adjustments via accommodation@orsted.com.

Please note that for your application to be taken into consideration, you must submit your application via our online career pages and answer the screening questions relevant for your country.

**Position salary range:

**For this position, the expected base pay range is kr62,160.00- kr93,240.00 for the advertised location. The offered base salary will be determined within this range based on relevant skills, experience, and expected role fulfilment within the stated pay range to ensure a fair and competitive offer. Where applicable, you may also be eligible for variable payment and a comprehensive benefits package.

**Our benefits package:

**For this position, employees who meet eligibility requirements have access to: employer‑paid pension (11% contribution), full insurance coverage (accident, life, critical illness, and health insurance); five weeks of paid holiday plus 10 additional paid days off per holiday year; a 3% holiday allowance; access to Ørsted Life & Fitness Vitality including fitness classes, physiotherapy, massage, and wellbeing programmes; a multimedia package (mobile phone, PC, internet); staff club membership with sport and cultural activities; and access to the company canteen (monthly lunch scheme or daily tickets).

**Pre-employment background check:

**Certain positions may require a background check as part of the hiring process. If applicable, you will be informed during the recruitment process. Background checks are conducted by an external provider in accordance with local legal requirements.

Imagine a future with Ørsted

Join a global leader in renewable energy

Ørsted is a global leader in offshore wind and is one of the largest renewable energy companies in the world. With us, you’ll play your part in creating a world that runs entirely on green energy. As a leading green energy company, we leverage the curiosity and passion of our people to innovate and develop new technologies or bring existing technologies to scale, collaborating with governments, suppliers, and our industry partners to make renewable energy solutions a reality. At Ørsted, we work together with openness and respect and seek fresh perspectives to solve any task at hand: big or small.

**About Ørsted

**

• We provide countries, companies, and communities with sustainable, reliable, and cost-competitive energy solutions, including offshore and onshore wind, solar PV, and energy storage.

• Our vision is to create a world that runs entirely on green energy.

• We built the world’s first offshore wind farm, Vindeby in Denmark, in 1991, and completed the world’s largest, Hornsea 2 in the UK, in 2022.

• We were founded in Denmark in 2006 and now have approximately 8,000 employees, working in 15 countries and counting.

An inclusive team

At Ørsted, we strive to be an inclusive workplace where you’re respected for who you are, valued for the unique perspectives you bring, and rewarded fairly for what you achieve. We want all employees to have the same opportunities for impact and growth, no matter their age, race, ethnicity, place of birth, gender, sexual orientation, or disability.

jobs.occupation: System Manager, AC Skid – BESS (Medium Voltage Containerized Systems)
jobs.description:
System Manager, AC Skid – BESS (Medium Voltage Containerized Systems)

Shape the backbone of the energy transition

Are you passionate about building reliable, future-ready energy systems?

Do you enjoy working at the intersection of electrical engineering, system integration, and real-world impact?

Highlights of the offer

• Job offer expiration: 30/11/2026

• Type of work: Hybrid

• Role: Individual Contributor / Specialist

• Location: Europe, Denmark

Responsibilities

Serve as the overall system‑responsible owner for the AC Skid, covering electrical/functional architecture, safety, quality, and lifecycle performance.

Lead supplier selection, qualification, and governance for the mechanical Skid design, ensuring alignment with system requirements, standards, and cost targets.

Own the technical selection and specification of:

• MV transformer

• RMU

• PCS (in house designed converter integration and interfaces

Ensure correct electrical and functional integration of all subsystems:

• MV transformer – RMU – PCS

• Grounding/earthing

• Cooling and auxiliary power

• Cabling, interlocks, protections, and monitoring

Review and validate supplier designs for the mechanical skid

Ensure compliance with relevant standards:

• MV equipment (IEC/ANSI)

• Transformer and switchgear safety

• Environmental, mechanical, and fire safety

Review supplier documentation, test results, FAT reports, and qualification data.

Drive quality and cost optimization, ensuring a price‑competitive and high‑quality AC Skid product for the BESS platform.

Support customer clarification and quotation phases, ensuring:

• Technical feasibility

• Clear interpretation of customer requirements

• Alignment between project needs and AC Skid capabilities

Collaborate cross‑functionally with electrical, mechanical, controls, product, procurement, and quality teams to ensure seamless AC Skid integration.

Our requirements

Must‑haves:

Bachelor’s/Master’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Power Systems, Energy Engineering, or similar.

Strong understanding of:

• MV transformers, RMUs, switchgear, and MV safety

• Grid‑connected PCS/power converters

• MV protection, grounding/earthing, and interlocking

• Cooling and auxiliary systems

Experience working with suppliers on:

• Detailed mechanical design reviews

• Documentation review and compliance checks

• Quality and cost evaluations

Ability to support technical clarifications during pre‑sales and quotation phases.

Nice‑to‑haves:

Experience with AC Skids, E‑houses, containerized MV designs, or BESS systems.

Knowledge of grid code requirements for MV‑connected BESS or hybrid power plants.

Familiarity with DFMEA, FAT processes, and utility compliance documentation.

Background in system engineering or product ownership roles.

Location

This role can be based in our offices in Ikast or Hammel, with flexibility for hybrid work.

Apply now! Send us your resume in English and help us build the energy systems of tomorrow.

Whether you’re interested in engineering, manufacturing, operations, or support functions, you’ll find opportunities at KK Group to grow your skills, contribute to meaningful work, and make an impact.

Karen Lim  +45 4194 6883

KK Group is a global technology partner delivering power, controls, cooling, monitoring and service solutions for renewable energy and energy-intensive industries.

jobs.occupation: Senior Cloud Engineer
jobs.description:
Ready to bridge innovation and operations in one of the Nordics' most recognized media brands?

Egmont IT is looking for a Senior Cloud Engineer profile who thrives on improving and automating cloud environments, while understanding the importance of stability, governance, and performance.

You’ll join Egmont’s Cloud Operations team, working primarily with Azure, AWS and partially in GCP. Egmont’s cloud footprint is very large and requires that all engineers think about automation and streamlining first.

Your Role & Impact We are looking for a colleague that is great at asking questions and challenging decisions. We want to build a modern, strong and scalable platform for our many subsidiaries(120+ companies) and we need the right people to do that.

You will be doing hands-on work on our many platforms and solutions to ensure that we constantly improve on new solutions. As well as evaluating old implementations to determine when it is time to modernize.

Responsibilities • Operate and optimize Egmont’s multi-cloud environments

• Automate routine and repetitive tasks and streamline operations.

• Strengthen observability and proactive monitoring in our tools – We use Datadog

• Use Infrastructure as Code to manage changes and enforce standard and detect drift

• Drive modernization initiatives to reduce manual work and promote automation

• Collaborate with developers, security, and infrastructure teams and business stakeholders to ensure stability and compliance

• Contribute ideas, challenge the status quo, and help evolve our culture

What You’ll Bring (Qualifications) We're looking for a blend of technical expertise and a collaborative, proactive mindset.

Desired Skills

• Experience from previous cloud engineering, operations or DevOps roles

• Strong hands-on experience with Azure or AWS (GCP is also a plus)

• Scripting skills in any popular language

• Experience with IaC tools, any apply but we use Terraform

• Good understanding of networking

• Experience working with modern observability tools like Datadog

• Knows how to setup, configure and operate server based infrastructure, running both Linux and Windows

• Working with source control in GitHub or similar providers

• Experience in agentic tooling and a curiosity in following latest trends

Personal Qualities

You can build, automate, and optimize, but you also know that reliability, performance, and security are the foundation of success. You’re curious, pragmatic, and want to be part of a team that’s rethinking how cloud operations are done.

Why Egmont? At Egmont IT, we enable creativity, not just for artist but also in tech. Behind every story, movie, game, or digital experience lies a foundation of stable and secure technology — and that’s where we come in.

Egmont is a foundation, meaning all our profits are reinvested into developing our media companies and donated to support vulnerable children and young people.

You’ll join an international IT organization with a strong purpose and culture. We believe in flexibility, trust, and development. You’ll have freedom to influence our cloud journey, collaborate with talented colleagues across the Nordics and Europe, and grow through certifications and learning opportunities. A key role in a cloud-driven operations team. A workplace that encourages innovation, collaboration, and autonomy. Flexible hybrid work setup (Copenhagen HQ + home office). A chance to make a real difference — We bring stories to life

Ready to join?

Logistics & How to Apply

• Location: Vognmagergade 11, 1120 Copenhagen K, Denmark

• Application deadline: November 14, 2026

• Interviews: Will be scheduled from week 47.

Please send your application as soon as possible — we review applications continuously. Applications are welcome in both Danish and English.

To apply, please use the "Apply Now" button on this page. Note that we do not accept applications via email.

If you have any questions about the role, feel free to contact Sabine Lübcke (Senior IT Manager, Cloud & Network) at sabine.lubcke@egmont.com

We look forward to hearing from you!

About Egmont

Egmont is a leading Nordic media group focused on strong content and platforms within film, tv, cinema, streaming, gaming, e-commerce, marketing services, educational platforms, magazines and books. Proud owner of strong companies like Nordisk Film, TV 2 in Norway, Lindhardt og Ringhof and Story House Egmont. Being a foundation, all profit is reinvested in our media companies and donated to help improve the lives of vulnerable children and young people and support film talents.

We bring stories to life.

jobs.occupation: Deloitte Master's Thesis Hub
jobs.description:
The Deloitte Master's Thesis Hub bridges bright students with unanswered questions Deloitte is curious about.

The program is a great place to meet like-minded students navigating the ups and downs of thesis writing. Best of all, you'll have the invaluable opportunity to get guidance and support during the writing process and tap into the expertise of Deloitte's thought leaders, who will guide you on the path of creating an impactful master thesis!

Our Deloitte experts will be able to provide collaboration and guidance within the following five research topics:

• M&A & Strategy

• Sustainability & ESG

• Financial Performance & Reporting

• Digital Transformation & AI

• Organization & Change Management

Deloitte invests in providing relevant business insight and latest industry trends, challenging your thought process, and giving access to a large network of experts in the specific problem domain. We help develop your problem-solving skills and show you tips and tricks to present research findings concisely. Most importantly, the Master's Thesis Hub offers a room for reflection and shared learning between participants and experts.

By applying to the Master’s Thesis Hub, you will commit to attending four dedicated sessions from January – April 2026 for shared learning and pro-level guidance. To round of the Master Thesis Hub we will have a celebration dinner in June 2026, to congratulate you on your new degree. All sessions will be held in the Deloitte office in Copenhagen (Weidekampsgade 6, 2300 Copenhagen S). Note that it is a requirement to attend all sessions physically at the Copenhagen office to be a part of the program.

Are you ready? We are looking forward to receiving your application!

How to apply?

To apply, click "I'm interested" and upload your CV (along with the CVs of your group members if applicable). You will also be asked to answer a few practical questions.

Final deadline for signing up is the 4th of December. You will receive a response regarding your application shortly thereafter.

We look forward to connecting with you!

In Deloitte, you will find passionate, caring people who are curious by nature and striving to evolve. We value our different skills, perspectives and experiences and foster an environment where innovative powers thrive. To us, success is the feeling that the work we are doing will outlast us. The impact we make is not about what we achieve as individuals, but how we enable those around us to be their very best. From professional development to leadership opportunities, we empower our people to be extraordinary by playing to their strengths – because that is how we can make a difference.

jobs.occupation: AI Execution Manager
jobs.description:
Location

Denmark or London/Oxford, United Kingdom

Job category

Research & Development

Department

AI & Digital Innovation, Research & Development

Location

This position can be based in either Denmark or London/Oxford, United Kingdom.

Your impact begins here

As AI Execution Manager, you will help shape how AI transforms Research & Development at Novo. Working at the intersection of science, digital innovation and business execution, you will partner with senior leaders, researchers and technology teams to turn strategic priorities into high-impact initiatives that create measurable value. Your work will accelerate the pace at which AI and digital capabilities translate into progress for people living with serious chronic diseases.

What you'll bring

• An advanced degree (Master's or PhD preferred) in life sciences, providing the scientific foundation to engage confidently with experts across Research & Development.

• A strategic mindset with the ability to bring structure to ambiguity, shape complex initiatives and connect scientific and technical opportunities with broader organisational priorities.

• A proven track record of leading high-impact initiatives, influencing senior stakeholders and building alignment across complex matrix organisations to deliver measurable outcomes.

• Strong digital and AI understanding, including appreciation of how technology products and capabilities are developed, implemented and scaled within large organisations.

• A demonstrated understanding of how large pharmaceutical or life sciences organisations operate, with experience working across scientific, technical and business functions.

• Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage effectively with scientific, technical and executive audiences.

• Fluency in written and spoken English.

Desirable:

• Experience from management consulting, digital transformation or a related strategic advisory environment.

• Direct experience in pharmaceutical or biotech R&D settings.

What you'll do

You will translate strategic AI and digital priorities into successful execution across Research & Development, from target discovery through to clinical development. Your focus will be on shaping, coordinating and delivering initiatives that create tangible organisational impact.

• Partner with scientific and business leaders to identify and shape high-impact AI and digital initiatives, translating opportunities into clear, actionable programmes.

• Lead complex cross-functional initiatives across R&D, including collaborations with external partners and technology leaders.

• Provide strategic guidance and coordination across AI initiatives, ensuring alignment between scientific objectives, technology capabilities and business priorities.

• Act as a trusted partner who translates between scientific, technical and business perspectives to support informed decision-making.

• Build alignment across senior stakeholders and drive complex initiatives through to successful delivery in a global matrix organisation.

Who you'll work with

You will join the AI Execution team within AI & Digital Innovation, part of Research & Development. The team partners across R&D, from target discovery through to clinical development, to identify, shape and deliver high-impact initiatives that create measurable value. Working across science, technology and business, your team helps transform ambitious ideas into tangible organisational impact.

Your closest partners will include senior scientific and business leaders across R&D, technology and digital teams, and external partners. You will work across functions and organisational levels, bringing different perspectives together to build alignment and move initiatives forward with clarity and pace.

What you can expect here

You will work at the forefront of AI and digital innovation in a global healthcare company that is investing significantly in science and technology. The role offers the opportunity to shape how R&D operates, build new skills through cross-functional collaboration and grow your expertise at the intersection of science, AI and business.

You will be trusted to take ownership, make your voice heard and contribute your expertise where it matters most. The work moves at pace, and curiosity, adaptability and a drive for impact are valued every day.

Salary: For this role, the Annual Base Salary ranges from 742,600.00 to 1,091,600.00 DKK, corresponding to the level of the position. The placement within the salary range will be assessed during the recruitment process based on the candidate's skills, competencies, knowledge and relevant experience.

Incentives and Benefits: The salary package may include short-term and/or long-term incentives as well as other employee benefits based on position level, location, functional area and relevant market benchmarks.

Learn more about our Reward Philosophy here

Start now

Your impact begins today. If you are ready to help shape how AI transforms Research & Development at Novo, apply for the AI Execution Manager role by 20th November. Interviews may begin during the posting period, so we encourage you to apply as soon as possible.

We are an equal opportunities employer and are committed to an inclusive recruitment process and equality of opportunity for all applicants.

jobs.occupation: Content Creator to DAMM Cellular Systems A/S
jobs.description:
Content Creator

Find the interesting. Make it understandable. Get it seen.

DAMM Cellular Systems builds communication systems for organisations worldwide that depend on them when communication matters most - from offshore installations and mines to airports and emergency response teams.

We're a technical company with deep expertise, customers operating in high-stakes environments, and an industry moving fast. There are plenty of stories and insights worth sharing. We need someone who can recognise what matters, find the right angle and turn it into content that reaches the people we want to reach.

This is not a traditional content writing role.

Writing is at the heart of it. But writing in isolation is no longer enough.

Today, how content gets discovered is just as important as what it says. Search engines, AI and social platforms are changing how people find and consume information. We need someone who understands these shifts and knows how to make our content more visible, relevant and effective - so it works for us, not the other way around.

What you'll do.

Understand our customers and uncover opportunities

Work closely with our sales teams and partners to understand customer needs, challenges and buying motivations. Draw on engineers and technical specialists to understand how our solutions deliver value. Identify stories, insights and opportunities worth communicating.

Bring our key messages to life

Understand DAMM's positioning, communication priorities, industries and target audiences. Find fresh ways to consistently reinforce our key messages, translate technical capabilities into meaningful customer benefits and communicate what makes DAMM different - without simply repeating ourselves.

Create content that matters

Turn customer insights, expertise, stories and proof points into clear, engaging content for our website, LinkedIn, newsletters and campaigns. Create articles, case studies, thought leadership content, short videos and podcast teasers. Support outreach activities.

Design for discovery

Understand how search, AI, social algorithms and emerging platforms influence what gets found, read and shared. Use that knowledge to shape content from the outset - how it's framed, structured, published and distributed.

Improve what works

Use data, feedback and digital tools to refine content and experiment with new approaches. Find smarter ways to research, create, repurpose content and improve workflows.

What we're looking for

You don't need a traditional background or a particular number of years on your CV. What matters is strong writing, editorial judgement, commercial awareness and curiosity about technology and digital communication.

• Experience creating content for professional audiences, ideally within B2B or technical industries.
• Excellent English writing and editing skills, with the ability to make complex subjects clear, relevant and engaging.
• An understanding of how content gets discovered and performs across digital channels - what makes people stop, read, watch or click.
• Confidence using digital tools and an interest in search and emerging technologies.
• The ability to adapt messages and content for different audiences, industries and formats.
• A proactive, curious mindset and the confidence to ask questions and take initiative.
• Experience creating or editing short-form video is an advantage.
 What you'll be part of

You'll join a small marketing team at our headquarters in Sønderborg, working closely with the Head of Marketing and colleagues across the business.

DAMM has around 80 colleagues representing more than 15 cultures, with teams and partners around the world. We’re an international, flat and team-oriented organisation where people take responsibility for their work, bring their own areas of expertise and work together towards a common goal.

What we offer

• The opportunity to shape how an international technology company communicates.
• A varied role combining writing, creativity, technology and digital communication.
• A small team where your work is visible and your ideas can make a difference.
• Health insurance, a lunch scheme, and social and sporting activities.
The position is based at our office in Sønderborg, Denmark.

How to apply

Forget the traditional cover letter.

Send us your CV and a short application answering two questions:

• What caught your attention about this role, and what would you bring to it?
• Share a piece of writing you're particularly proud of. What makes it work, and why?
Please include examples of your work.

We'd also love to see a short video (around 60 seconds) introducing yourself. Your phone is fine, and no editing is needed. It's completely optional, but it's a nice way for us to get a feel for you.

If you have questions about the role, contact: Lone Hansen, Head of Marketing, at +45 2986 7350.

jobs.occupation: Bra Innovation Designer
jobs.description:
Summary: Overall Job Purpose

As a Bra Innovation Designer, you will lead the creative development of innovative bra products across our lingerie collections, with a particular focus on moulded cup technologies, new constructions, materials and functional design solutions.

You will combine a strong fashion sensibility with specialist knowledge of bra design, translating customer needs, market insights and emerging textile technologies into commercially relevant products that deliver CHANGE's Perfect Fit philosophy.

Working across our two annual fashion collections and ongoing product development initiatives, you will drive new product concepts from initial research and design through prototyping, sample development and production readiness. You will collaborate closely with Technical Design, Production, Planning and our manufacturing partners in China to develop products that balance innovation, aesthetics, comfort, support, quality and commercial viability.

Essential Duties & Responsibilities

·         Research emerging trends, bra innovations, competitor products, textile technologies and customer needs to identify new product development opportunities.

·         Lead the design and development of innovative bra concepts, including moulded cup bras, seamless and bonded constructions, wireless solutions and new support technologies.

·         Explore moulding techniques, foam and spacer materials, cup shapes, pad and wire solutions, innovative fabrics, elastics and construction methods in collaboration with Technical Design, Production and suppliers.

·         Develop new silhouettes and design solutions that enhance fit, comfort, support and aesthetics across CHANGE’s extensive size range, including larger cup sizes.

·         Create detailed design sketches, technical drawings, concept presentations and collection overviews using Adobe Creative Suite.

·         Initiate raw material research, sourcing and development with suppliers, including new material technologies and alternative sourcing opportunities.

·         Work closely with Technical Design on prototype fittings, construction development, material performance and product refinement, supporting the achievement of approved fit and quality standards.

·         Collaborate with manufacturing partners in China to develop prototypes, evaluate new manufacturing capabilities and translate innovative concepts into commercially viable products.

·         Assess target costs, manufacturing feasibility and design-to-cost opportunities to achieve category margin objectives.

·         Create and maintain accurate design information in PLM, including sketches, materials, trims, colorways, design BOM components and development updates.

·         Support product commercialization through product descriptions, key product features, innovation storytelling and collaboration with Marketing.

·         Contribute to continuous improvement of bra design standards, product performance and the development of new product categories.

KPIs

·         On-Time Milestone Delivery: Percentage of assigned design and innovation deliverables completed within agreed collection deadlines.

·         Product Innovation: Delivery of approved new bra concepts, moulded cup solutions, materials and construction innovations against agreed development objectives.

·         First-Time Sample Accuracy: Percentage of initial samples meeting approved design specifications without significant aesthetic or construction-related design corrections.

·         Design Cost Compliance: Percentage of developed styles meeting target FOB costs and category margin objectives.

·         PLM Data Accuracy & Completeness

·         Commercial Performance: Performance of launched innovation products against agreed sales, sell-through and category objectives.

Ideal Profile

You are an experienced and technically curious designer with a genuine passion for lingerie, product innovation and the relationship between design, fit and function.

You bring specialist knowledge of bra construction and moulded cup products, together with a strong understanding of textile materials, manufacturing processes and emerging technologies. You enjoy exploring new solutions, challenging existing product constructions and translating complex technical possibilities into desirable, commercially relevant designs.

jobs.occupation: 2 Assistant Professor Positions (non-tenured) with a Focus on Innovation in Pharmacy or Medicinal Chemistry at SDU in Odense
jobs.description:
The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy at the University of Southern Denmark (SDU) invites applications for 2 positions as Assistant Professor with a focus on innovation within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

The positions are expected to commence on 1 February 2027 or as soon as possible thereafter. Each position is fixed-term for 3 years.

The positions are intended for talented early-career researchers who wish to develop an independent academic profile at the intersection of research, innovation and education. The successful candidates will conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry and contribute to translating scientific knowledge into solutions with potential value for patients, healthcare, society or the pharmaceutical and biotechnology sectors.

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy is one of four departments at the Faculty of Science and is located at SDU’s main campus in Odense. The department is responsible for educational programmes in chemistry, medicinal chemistry and physics, as well as the bachelor’s programme in pharmacy. The successful candidates will join the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and become part of an interdisciplinary research environment with strong opportunities for collaboration across scientific fields and with external partners.

 

Research and innovation profile

The assistant professors will develop and conduct research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear focus on innovation and application. Relevant research may include, but is not limited to, the discovery, design, development, formulation, delivery, analysis or evaluation of pharmaceutical substances, technologies and products. Innovation is understood broadly and may involve the development or application of new:

• 
compounds, drug candidates or therapeutic concepts;

• 
formulations, drug-delivery systems or pharmaceutical products;

• 
experimental, analytical, computational or data-driven methods;

• 
technologies, platforms, processes or research tools;

• 
approaches to solving challenges relevant to patients, healthcare, society or industry.

The successful candidates are expected to identify the innovation potential of their research and contribute to its maturation and translation. Depending on the nature and stage of the research, this may include validation of concepts, development of prototypes or proof of concept, collaboration with relevant users and external partners, protection of intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or other pathways to application and impact.

The positions provide an opportunity for early-career researchers to develop an independent research and innovation profile. Applicants are therefore not expected to have an extensive record of patents, commercialization or entrepreneurship. Relevant previous experience is an advantage, but equal emphasis will be placed on the applicant’s scientific qualifications, motivation and potential to develop innovative research.

 

Roles and responsibilities

The assistant professors will be expected to:

• 
Establish and develop an independent research programme within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry with a clear innovation perspective.

• 
Conduct high-quality research and communicate the results through scientific publications, conferences and relevant outreach activities.

• 
Identify and explore the scientific, societal and/or commercial potential of research ideas and results.

• 
Develop research-based concepts, methods, technologies or solutions towards validation, proof of concept or application, where relevant.

• 
Establish collaborations across disciplines and engage with relevant academic and external partners, such as companies, hospitals, healthcare professionals, public authorities, innovation environments or other users.

• 
Apply for or contribute to applications for external research and innovation funding.

• 
Contribute to teaching and course development within the department’s educational programmes, particularly pharmacy, medicinal chemistry and related areas.

• 
Contribute to research-based and innovation-oriented teaching, including the involvement of students in relevant research and innovation activities.

• 
Supervise and mentor bachelor’s and master’s students and, where relevant, contribute to the supervision of PhD students and other junior researchers.

• 
Participate actively in the academic environment and contribute to the continued development of the department’s research, innovation and educational activities.

• 
Participate in public engagement, knowledge exchange and other activities that strengthen the relationship between the university and the surrounding society.

 

The ideal candidate

We seek ambitious and collaborative early-career researchers with:

• 
A PhD degree in pharmacy, medicinal chemistry, pharmaceutical sciences, chemistry or another closely related field.

• 
A strong scientific background relevant to research within pharmacy or medicinal chemistry.

• 
The ability and motivation to develop an independent research and innovation profile.

• 
A clear interest in translating scientific knowledge into new concepts, methods, technologies, products, practices or other solutions.

• 
The potential to identify relevant needs and opportunities and engage with academic and external partners.

• 
Good communication and collaboration skills and an interest in interdisciplinary research.

• 
Proficiency in spoken and written English.

 

Experience in one or more of the following areas will be considered an advantage but is not a requirement:

• 
Translational or application-oriented research.

• 
Interdisciplinary collaboration.

• 
Collaboration with industry, hospitals, healthcare organizations, public authorities or other external partners.

• 
Development and validation of methods, technologies, prototypes or proof-of-concept studies.

• 
Intellectual property, technology transfer, entrepreneurship or commercialization.

• 
Participation in applications for research or innovation funding.

• 
Innovation-oriented teaching or student activities.

As the positions are aimed at early-career researchers, applicants will be assessed in relation to their career stage. Applicants are not required to demonstrate an established innovation track record. A convincing motivation and a realistic plan for developing innovative research will be central to the assessment.

 

The research and innovation environment

The Department of Physics, Chemistry and Pharmacy provides a highly collaborative environment that brings together experimental, computational and theoretical research. The department offers broad opportunities for collaboration within research, innovation, funding applications and teaching.

The successful candidates will become part of the sections for Chemistry and Pharmacy and will have opportunities to collaborate with researchers across the department, the Faculty of Science, other faculties at SDU and relevant external organizations.

SDU provides access to an extensive innovation ecosystem that supports researchers in developing ideas and exploring pathways towards application and impact. Depending on the individual project, this may include support for innovation funding, collaboration with external partners, intellectual property, technology maturation, entrepreneurship and business development.

The assistant professors will be expected to contribute actively to this environment and to help strengthen connections between excellent research, education, innovation and society.

 

What we offer

The successful candidates will be offered:

• 
The opportunity to establish an independent research and innovation profile in a supportive academic environment.

• 
Access to interdisciplinary research communities and relevant experimental, analytical and computational infrastructure.

• 
Opportunities to collaborate with academic and external partners.

• 
Support for the development of applications for research and innovation funding.

• 
Access to relevant mentoring, career-development and pedagogical activities.

• 
Opportunities to contribute to the further development of innovation within the department’s research and educational programmes.

Du vil skulle arbejde i et 3-ugers rul. Arbejdstiden er om eftermiddagen og skifter i tidsrummet ml. kl. 10.00 og kl. 23.00. Der må påregnes overarbejde i travle perioder.

Dine faglige kvalifikationer

• 
Du har kørekort til C/E, chaufføruddannelsesbevis, førerkort og truckcertifikat

• 
Du har erfaring fra en lignende stilling

• 
Du taler og skriver dansk og/eller engelsk

Dine personlige kvalifikationer

Du er som person selvstændig, serviceminded og sætter en ære i at gøre tingene ordentligt. Som medarbejder og kollega er du fleksibel på arbejdstiden, mødestabil og imødekommende. Du arbejder effektivt uden at miste fokus på sikkerheden, og du har lyst til at give vores kunder en god oplevelse, hvor end du kommer.

Om REMA 1000

I REMA 1000 er vi mere end 17.500 entusiastiske mennesker med ét fælles mål: Vi vil være bedst til at drive dagligvarebutik i Danmark – med fokus på kvalitet til lave priser. Det absolut vigtigste element i den mission er engagerede og virkelystne mennesker, som elsker at gøre en forskel i deres job.

Vi har i dag flere end 440 butikker, og butikkerne er drevet efter en franchisemodel med selvstændige, lokalkendte købmænd i spidsen for den enkelte butik.

I Baglandet hos REMA 1000 / REMA Distribution er vi mere end 1.300 medarbejdere, som skaber konkurrencekraft, servicerer og leverer varer til REMA 1000 butikkerne og andre kæder indenfor dagligvare- og convenience branchen.

Lyder det som noget for dig?Så send os en ansøgning til Drifschef Brian Schmidt på mail: bsc@rema1000.dk .

Vi ser frem til at høre fra dig. 

Vi vurderer ansøgningerne løbende, og jobannoncen vil derfor blive fjernet når passende kandidat er fundet.

ENGLISH:

We are currently looking for a Yard Driver to join REMA Distribution A/S, Hjulmagervej 12, Vejle in Denmark.

As an employee at REMA Distribution, you will become part of a company that aims to be the best at operating grocery stores in Denmark, with a focus on providing quality at low prices. You will play an important role in this process and become part of our yard shunter team in Vejle, working alongside skilled and competent colleagues.

About the job

Reporting to the Operations Manager, you will be part of a team working closely with our warehouse and logistics department.

Responsibilities

·       Your duties will include:

·       Operating a yard driver within the terminal area.

·       Connect and Disconnect trailers.

·       Preparing trailers for loading and unloading.

·       Operating forklifts and carrying out internal transport.

·       Loading, unloading and handling goods.

·       Performing warehouse and terminal duties as required.

·       Cleaning of Terberg.

Our warehouse team ensures that trailers are loaded and ready before they need to be moved.

You will have an independent and challenging full-time position with pay in accordance with the applicable collective agreement, as well as a pension scheme and health insurance.

You will work on a 3-week rotating schedule. Your working hours will vary between 10:00 and 23:00. Overtime should be expected during busy periods.

Your professional qualifications

• 
You hold a valid Category C/E driving licence, Driver Certificate of Professional Competence (CPC), driver card and forklift licence

• 
You have experience from a similar position

• 
You are able to speak and write Danish and/or English

Your personal qualities

You are independent, service-minded and take pride in doing your job properly.

As an employee and colleague, you are flexible regarding working hours, reliable and approachable. You work efficiently without compromising safety, and you are motivated to provide our customers with a positive experience wherever your work takes you.

About REMA 1000

At REMA 1000, we are more than 17,500 enthusiastic employees working towards one common goal: to be the best at operating grocery stores in Denmark, with a focus on providing quality at low prices.

The most important element in achieving this mission is having dedicated and motivated people who are passionate about making a difference in their work.

Today, we have more than 435 stores, operated according to a franchise model, with independent local franchisees responsible for each individual store.

At REMA 1000 / REMA Distribution's support organisation, we have more than 1,300 employees who help strengthen our competitiveness, provide services and deliver goods to REMA 1000 stores and other chains within the grocery and convenience sector.

Does this sound like the job for you?

Please send your application to Operations Manager Brian Schmidt by email at bsc@rema1000.dk.

We look forward to hearing from you.

jobs.occupation: Mechanical Project Engineer - FEM/FEA
jobs.description: Every day, we get opportunities to make a positive impact - on our colleagues, partners, customers, and society. Together, we're pioneering the solutions of the future and unlocking the full potential of precious resources. Trusted to act on initiative, we challenge conventional thinking to develop world-leading technologies that inspire progress in vital areas, including energy, food, water, and shipping.  As we push forward, the innovative, open spirit that fuels our 140-year-old start-up culture and rapid growth also drives our personal growth. So, as we shape a more resourceful, less wasteful world, we build our careers too. About the job Ready to take on challenging mechanical engineering work with a clear purpose? With us you will contribute to global priorities such as energy efficiency, clean water, and Alfa Laval's net-zero 2030 ambition. Let's shape a better tomorrow together!  We design and supply process solutions within various industries, mainly water treatment. As a Mechanical Engineer and FEM/FEA specialist, you will design solutions in 3D with detailed engineering combined with standard components. Our designs contain pipes, pumps, decanters, evaporators, membranes, heat exchangers etc.  Your work involves verification and optimization of mechanical and process equipment, by identifying critical stress concentrations, deformations, and failure modes etc. In this role, you will perform simulations as well as traditional hand calculations to ensure our products meet functional, safety, and regulatory requirements. During project execution you will be working in global project teams with Project Managers, Process Specialists, Automation, Sourcing, and Workshops.  Key tasks and responsibilities:     Design steel structures, skid solutions and custom designs in Autodesk Inventor     FEM/FEA analysis on mechanical designs using ANSYS/Nastran including: Static structural, Buckling, Hydrostatic and internal  pressure, Vibrations and fatigue, Thermal and Pipe support.     Hand calculations     Prepare clear technical reports and design recommendations     Review boundary conditions and results from simulations made by others     Optimize calculation methods, templates, engineering standards, and best practices     DFM in collaboration with workshop and FAT/SAT     Review 3D designs and 2D drawings     Ensure compliance with Machinery Regulation (EU) 2023/1230 and CE marking     Apply relevant standards like ASCE/SEI 7-22 and EN1993-1-1  Planned travels, mostly within Europe, for inspections and commissioning is part of the job - approximately 20 - 25 days per year. You will be part of an innovative mechanical team of ten who are continuously implementing smarter ways of working. You report to Jesper Bergstrøm, a people-oriented leader who is passionate about his team thriving in their roles and look forward to going to work. At Alfa Laval, we embrace a hybrid work model, allowing you to work from home when it aligns with your tasks.   Who are you You are a results-driven, high-energy professional who maintains focus and a positive attitude while pursuing ambitious goals. You take initiative, make calculated decisions with confidence, and consistently turn plans into action. You build strong networks across and beyond the organization, using your relational skills to influence, collaborate, and create impact. Proactive, timely, and quality-minded, you work effectively with others and help drive collective success.  What you know We are looking for you with solid skills and experience in FEM/FEA analysis with skid- and steel structures solutions. The role involves a lot of collaboration and while you can independently, we believe you enjoy collaborating across disciplines and are able to communicate complex technical topics clearly.  Requirements:     Degree in Mechanical Engineering     Deep knowledge in FEM/FEA analysis with skid- and steel structures solutions.     Working proficiency in defining the scope, building an efficient model, performing the analysis, interpreting the results, and delivering clear engineering conclusions within a typical timeframe of 1-2 weeks depending on complexity.     Excellent communication skills in English   For more information, please contact Jesper Bergstrøm, Engineering Manager, Mechanical Engineering & Design, WIFH PM&E +45 4271 8160 Charlotta Lundblad, Talent Acquisition Partner   We are conducting a continuous review of received applications and the ad might be closed before ending date. We do not accept applications via email, due to General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR). Please send your application no later than November 25, 2026. We will remove the job advert from our website as soon as we have found the right candidate, so don't wait too long! At Alfa Laval, we pride ourselves on creating an inclusive and dynamic workplace that values diverse perspectives and experiences. While we typically welcome applicants from all locations, for this particular role, we are prioritizing candidates who are currently residing in Søborg (Denmark) or have an established presence in the area.  Our commitment to integrity We care about diversity, inclusion, and equity in our recruitment processes. We also believe behavioural traits can provide important insights into a candidate's fit to a role. To help us achieve this we apply Pymetrics assessments, and upon application you will be invited to play the assessment games.  #LI-CL1
